title: Shenzhen's Historic Dongmen Old Street: A Cultural and Commercial Hub
description: Xueting Li explored Shenzhen's Dongmen Old Street, the city's earliest commercial center. From traditional architecture and bustling markets to famous snacks and vibrant culture, discover the history and modern charm of this iconic pedestrian street!
